_about: Good metadata for registering the MODFLOW engines into the MINT v2 model catalog. register_to_mint.py merges this with each variant's app.json (image, fileInputs, appArgs) to build Software -> SoftwareVersion -> ModelConfiguration -> Setup payloads. Per-package INPUTS are derived from app.json fileInputs; OUTPUTS + parameters + regions/GAMs come from here.

software.label: MODFLOW
software.description: The USGS MODFLOW family of modular, finite-difference groundwater flow models. A single Software grouping the supported engine versions (MODFLOW 6, MODFLOW-USG, MODFLOW-2000, MODFLOW-96), each packaged as a containerized Tapis app runnable on TACC.

package_labels.nam: Name file (lists active packages and unit numbers)
package_labels.support: Auxiliary support file (referenced by a package)
package_labels.simulation-archive: Full simulation bundle (zip of all input files)

_svo_about: Standard variables use SVO/CSDMS object__quantity names (double underscore between Phenomenon object and Property quantity). To match the catalog convention, each StandardVariable is minted under the catalog namespace https://w3id.org/okn/i/mint/<name> with same_as -> the canonical SVO IRI https://www.geoscienceontology.org/svo/svl/variable/<name>. reuse_existing=true means the variable already existed in the catalog (head, storativity) and is reused rather than duplicated. svo_bindings attaches a StandardVariable + Unit (VariablePresentation) to the meaningful MODFLOW I/O by package/output code; file-bundle packages (nam/dis/oc/support) are left unbound.

modflow6.label: MODFLOW 6
modflow6.description: MODFLOW 6 — the current core USGS modular hydrologic model. Object-oriented framework supporting structured (DIS), vertex (DISV), and unstructured (DISU) grids and multi-model simulations. Driven by the mfsim.nam simulation name file.
modflow6.usage_notes: Container entrypoint runs `mf6` in the staged simulation directory. Provide a full simulation.zip, or individual package files; missing files fall back to an optional baseline data directory.

modflow-usg.label: MODFLOW-USG
modflow-usg.description: MODFLOW-USG (UnStructured Grid) — supports control-volume finite-difference grids with the Sparse Matrix Solver (SMS) and Ghost-Node Correction (GNC). Uses classic *.nam name files.
modflow-usg.usage_notes: Container runs `mfusg model.nam`. USG-specific packages include SMS and GNC.

modflow-2000.label: MODFLOW-2000
modflow-2000.description: MODFLOW-2000 — legacy modular three-dimensional finite-difference groundwater model with Block-Centered Flow (BCF), the Geometric Multigrid solver (GMG), and Streamflow Routing (STR). Uses classic *.nam name files.
modflow-2000.usage_notes: Container runs `mf2000 model.nam`. Primary entrypoint for the target GAM is ygjk_tr.nam.

modflow-96.label: MODFLOW-96
modflow-96.description: MODFLOW-96 — the legacy USGS modular model (pre-2000 conventions). Compiled from the official USGS source archive; name file is supplied via stdin. Package data files use the legacy *.dat layout.
modflow-96.usage_notes: Container runs `mf96` with the name file piped on stdin. Legacy *.dat package files; trnt_h_ss.nam is a typical entrypoint.
